summary: Show the generated research report directly on the home screen after a research run completes, instead of only indicating that it was saved to an output file.
Handle interrupted or empty model responses gracefully so the UI never shows an empty report and clearly warns the user.

Tighten the research prompt to explicitly demand concise, insight-focused outputs with real numeric levels and symbol references, and update the UI helper text to match the user’s preference for fewer generic warnings and more actionable structure.

Introduce a simple Yahoo Finance daily-data helper and expose a basic analysis endpoint so downstream agents or future UI changes can fetch explicit, timestamped daily prices without altering existing research flows.
